jobs.occupation: Fluid Systems Engineer (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description: Mission Brief The goal of safe, reliable and rapid testing and space launch operations can only be achieved with support from a wide range of rigorously designed and developed ground infrastructure. This includes ground equipment, such as test stands for research & development, qualification and acceptance testing of propulsion systems and rocket stages, as well as entire launchpads. Close cooperation with other departments such as Propulsion Technology and Launch Vehicle is necessary since their requirements dictate the design of the ground support equipment. As a Fluid Systems Engineer, you take on a coordinative role, owning an engineering module/system, having the complete lifecycle in mind. You make sure that the design approaches applied are consistent across multiple projects while synergies are exploited to build reliable and safe systems, according to specification. You are responsible for the delivery of the systems according to specification and work closely together with design engineers to reach this goal efficiently. Your Role in Our Space Mission: Reporting directly to the Manager Ground Fluid Systems, the engineer's tasks are focused on but not necessarily limited to: - Own engineering modules/systems within larger projects, including status reporting, issue escalation, and proactive management of requirements with stakeholders across multiple (sub)systems. - Identifying problems and risks in the project realisation and escalating them properly. - Coordinate, plan, drive design and commissioning activities with design engineers. - Develop and update harmonized design approaches and incorporate lessons learned into processes and project delivery. Ensure compliance with regulatory and harmonized internal standards through design reviews. - Support procurement and delivery of systems/services with process plant engineering, ensuring specifications are met. - Contribute to design reviews which are in the field of expertise, keeping adjacent topics in mind. - Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and advise on rocket propulsion aspects of test and launch facility design. Qualification Checklist Education: Bachelor or Master's degree in, Aerospace/Process/Chemical/Mechanical/Energy Engineering or equivalent Experience: 2 - 5 years of relevant professional experience in aerospace, oil & gas, energy, chemical industry, engineering service provider or similar Hard skills: - In-depth knowledge of systems engineering approaches and tools for facility and space systems - In-depth knowledge in the field of rocket propulsion test facility design/or basic experience of their operation - Knowledge of thermodynamic and fluid mechanical processes and their application to real hardware - Basic knowledge of cryogenic & high- and low-pressure gas systems and relevant industry standards in the context of rocket testing and launching and/or process facilities - Basic capability to use project management tools - Strong analytical skills and ability to apply theoretical knowledge to find practical solutions for engineering challenges - First professional experiences with process/operational safety Soft skills - Mission Brief The Chief Quality Inspector is the independent authority responsible for defining how product conformity is verified across manufacturing operations. This role establishes inspection strategies, verification methods, conformity assessment criteria, and competency standards to ensure objective evidence exists that every product meets defined requirements.The position is driving a quality-at-source culture and a scalable inspection framework capable of supporting company growth. The Chief Quality Inspector ensures inspection activities provide reliable product acceptance decisions and robust evidence of compliance throughout the manufacturing lifecycle.Your Role in Our Space Mission: - Define and govern the company inspection strategy, acceptance approaches, and verification methodologies.- Establish conformity assessment criteria and ensure objective evidence supports all product acceptance decisions.- Own inspection governance, standards, procedures, and inspection-related competency frameworks.- Lead laboratory functions including material testing, metallography, composite testing, calibration activities, and failure investigations.- Support process qualification activities by defining required verification and inspection evidence.- Drive implementation of quality-at-source principles across manufacturing operations.- Ensure inspection resources, technologies, and capabilities can scale with future production demand.- Develop and maintain inspector training, qualification, certification, and recertification requirements.- Partner with Manufacturing, Production Engineering, Product Assurance, and Supplier Quality to resolve conformity concerns and improve product quality.- Provide clear conformity recommendations and inspection performance reporting to senior leadership.Qualification Checklist - At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide. The roleAs Head of Video, Berlin, you will shape how HelloFresh makes video for our international markets: the paid social engine, organic social, and our long-form YouTube content. Building and managing the team and systems behind all of it. You will lead the Berlin video team, including our international XPod, our fast and experimental content engine. Paid social is our biggest growth lever and the largest part of this role, but we do not want to lose the rest. Organic, long-form and brand storytelling all matter, and a strong Head of Video makes them work together. Whilst the scope is on our International market, we actively seek greater global collaboration. HelloFresh is at a pivotal moment of transformation. We are moving towards a modular, global content system, bringing AI-assisted workflows into how we plan, shoot and edit, and balancing centralised brand standards with local market needs. Berlin makes content for up to 14 markets that each need localisation, translation and cultural care, with local market teams who have a say on what ships. Our international XPod is a younger team than its New York counterpart, and part of your job is to bring it to the same standard, cadence and strategy.You will need to be as comfortable discussing channel metrics, spend and creative testing as you are discussing a script or a shot. You will partner closely with the Growth, Creative Strategy and Brand teams, with the XPod Director in North America, and with our Photo, AI, Culinary and Studio Operations teams, and you will have a real voice in how video works across the whole group.What you’ll doStudio Leadership & PeopleA strong video team is how we keep creative capability and institutional knowledge through a period of rapid change. You will lead, develop and inspire the Berlin video team, across XPod, organic social and long-form.- Set clear performance expectations, agree individual growth plans, and keep a healthy performance culture through regular 1:1s and honest, timely feedback.- Build and develop a team that spans producers, editors, creative strategists and post-production, and create career paths that keep talent with us.- Hire well, onboard well and keep the standard high as the team grows, including moving roles from freelance to full-time where it makes sense.- Create an open, supportive team culture where concerns are raised early and good ideas can come from anyone.Paid Social & PerformancePaid social is where we see the strongest return for the business. You will make international XPod a fast, reactive and experimental performance engine.- Deliver paid social content that performs, to brief, prioritised with the Growth and channel teams.- Run a clear test-and-learn rhythm across hooks, formats, creators and channels, and use performance data, including spend and cost per result, to decide what to make next.- Attend regular Growth meetings to align on performance, localisation, trends and channel spend, and turn what you learn into briefs and shoot plans quickly.- Build a lean creative strategy function inside the team that works hand in hand with Growth and Brand.- Bring Berlin XPod up to the cadence, tooling and strategy of our most mature XPod team, and share one way of working.Organic & Long-Form YouTubeWe want to keep investing in organic and long-form content alongside paid. Both build the brand and feed the paid engine.- Own the organic social video plan and grow it with the right talent, cadence and measures.- Lead our long-form YouTube content, currently focused on the UK, and develop it into a global proposition where the audience and the budget support it.- Make sure every long-form and organic shoot creates cut-downs, hooks and pickup shots that can serve paid, search and YouTube campaigns.- Keep the quality and storytelling of our brand video high, from short-form to long-form.Localisation & Modular ContentBerlin serves up to 14 markets, and doing that well is a core part of the role.- Build a modular approach: core shoots and footage libraries that adapt, with hooks and local elements changing by market.- Run localisation, translation and market adaptation as a managed, efficient process, with clear rules on what is shared and what is local.- Work with local market teams, who provide input on stories, formats and talent, to agree what is global and what is local without slowing delivery.- Establish batching and version control so one shoot creates many outputs, with clear naming, tagging and delivery.Production, Post-Production & WorkflowGood systems give creative people the room to do their best work.- Own the video workflow from brief through to casting, shooting, edit, localisation and final delivery.- Improve briefing standards, post-shoot reviews and production processes, so that learning builds up over time.- Work with Studio Operations, who own capacity planning, to schedule demand across brands and markets.- Make sure tools for tagging, metadata and asset management are used properly by every team that should be using them.- Create or expand our workflows for Influencer and Partnership content. AI & InnovationAI is changing how we plan, shoot, edit and version video. You will use it to amplify the team, not to replace its judgement.- Work with our AI team to decide where AI is the right tool: for versioning, editing and variants, and for what a shoot could not do practically.- Bring real shoots and AI-assisted work together in one workflow, with clear roles and honest communication about changes.- Test new formats, techniques and equipment, and show the results to creative and brand teams to widen what we can try.Delivery, Budget & Vendors- Own the video budget: forecast monthly and quarterly, allocate prudently and re-forecast as things change.- Manage vendors, agencies and freelancers, and brief them so that their output is useful across channels and markets, including paid.- Be accountable for on-time delivery and quality, and escalate delivery risks early with a recommendation.Cross-Functional Partnership- Partner closely with Growth, Creative Strategy, Brand, Studio Operations, Photo, AI and Culinary teams.- Work with the XPod Director in North America to align standards, learning and ways of working.- Be an ambassador for video across the company, building trusted relationships up to VP level.What you’ll bringYou are a senior video leader who combines real production craft with a deep understanding of paid social, and who loves content being made. You are as comfortable in a conversation about hooks, spend and cost per result as you are on set or in an edit.- Significant experience leading an in-house video or social content team in a high-volume, multi-brand environment.- Deep paid social knowledge: how creative performs on Meta, TikTok and YouTube, how spend and cost per result shape decisions, and how to run creative testing that changes what you make next.- A strong track record in organic social and long-form video, with a clear view of how they support paid and brand.- Proven experience managing multi-market content, including localisation, translation and working with local market teams.- Hands-on production and post-production knowledge, including how lighting, camera and edit decisions affect speed and quality, and a willingness to be on set.- Experience with AI-assisted workflows and a balanced view of where they help and where real production is better.- A record of developing people, building teams and managing change, with a decisive, calm and empathetic leadership style.- Credibility with senior stakeholders, including at VP level, across creative and commercial functions, and the confidence to say no with reasons.- A collaborative, respectful and proactive approach in an international team. Fluent English is required, and German is a plus.What we offerElevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.- Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.- Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.- Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.- Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.- Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave opErgänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Videobearbeitung, Video-Content, Gruppen-, Teamleitung

Experience in contract management? Interested in an international environment and renewable energies? Then we have the perfect opportunity for you!The CPX (Customer Project Execution) department is responsible for the project management of all wind farm projects from the start of the contract to completion. The team will take responsibility for a wind farm after the contract has been signed and will remain responsible until the final tests have been completed. Working closely with the logistics, procurement, and finance departments, the project team ensures that the project stays on budget and on schedule, and that our safety and quality standards are met. In addition, the project team works closely with the sales and legal departments to ensure that each wind farm delivers the highest energy yield within the customer specification.ResponsibilitiesContract management safeguards Vestas' commercial interests during the construction phase of new wind farms. During this phase, we take on core tasks and support the project team with proactive and constant advice and recommendations on commercial and contractual issues related to the implementation of a project in terms of safety, quality, time and budget. For individual construction projects, Contract Management provides direct contract management support to the project team. The Contract Manager also ensures coordination with internal departments, including the legal and financial departments, sales and bid management. Your tasks will include:- Commercial and contractual support during the construction phase of new wind farms, including advising internal stakeholders on turbine supply contracts- Enforcing claims against clients and subcontractors as well as conducting negotiations with these parties- Ensuring compliance with internal processes in the creation, filing and documentation of correspondence and records- Responsibility for claims management, including assessment of potential damage scenarios, derivation of recommendations and writing formal letters- Contribution to risk management (ONS) through identification and assessment of contractual risks- Capture and analyze contract-related insights to help optimize and evolve contract structures- Working closely with internal stakeholders and management to ensure effective implementation of contractual obligationsQualifications- Academic degree in law or business law (Bachelor's, Master's or Diploma)- At least 4 years of professional experience in drafting, reviewing, negotiating and managing contracts- Sound knowledge of construction and energy contracts, preferably with experience in power plant projects (FIDIC or EPCI is an advantage) is an advantage- Language skills: Fluent in German and English, both oral and writtenCompetencies- Strong methodological, analytical and problem-solving skills as well as a structured, independent way of working- Ability to work in a team, intercultural understanding and very good communication skills at all levels – internally and externally- Willingness to travel of up to 20%Your benefits – because your commitment counts! - Start & Perspective: Structured onboarding program and a permanent employment contract with long-term prospects - Development & Experience: Varied work in a forward-looking industry and individual opportunities for professional growth - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Overtime account, option to work from home up to 8 days per month, Extra days off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve, and the option for a sabbatical - Add-Ons: Business bike, gym allowance, company pension plan, Germany-wide train ticket (Deutschlandticket) - Team & Culture: Scandinavian-inspired with flat hierarchies, informal culture, and team spirit
